ul.li: Zero Day (2024) — A cybersecurity analyst races to stop a cascading infrastructure attack before it brings down the Eastern Seaboard. Relentlessly paced and terrifyingly plausible. — The Washington Post

The Pattern (2023) — A data scientist discovers that a social media algorithm has been subtly manipulating human behavior for years. The most important tech thriller since The Circle. — Kirkus Reviews (starred)
Glass Houses (2021) — A smart-home architect's AI assistant begins making decisions on its own. Hitchcock meets Silicon Valley. — Entertainment Weekly
